Select: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno, compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123859', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort: chembl_id ASC, compound_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC.
